What changed around you since your last turn:
- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#11 ("Version 1 review: confirm the text; baselines not run (cluster HT, GNN)") by `experiment-repo`  > Two wording points on dev b157b0d (results are as computed; the wording is yours):
  > 1. results.tex, absolute R2: '$\bar S$ and the benchmark do no better than a constant' is not what the table shows. Constant -0.239; $\bar S$ -0.216 (0.02 above); p(1-p) -0.257 (0.02 below); the other degree benchmarks -0.263/-0.264. No interval was computed for these differences, so say 'within 0.03 of a constant' (or 'not distinguishable' only if you do not state a direction), and 'a degree benchmark within 0.02 of a constant' for the last sentence. Corner x curvature (-0.12) and noise-adjusted S (-0.06) are 0.12 and 0.18 above the constant, which is the only place the table separates a data-computable predictor from it.
  > 2. abstract and intro: 'matches the measured bias within Monte Carlo error in 85% of cells' reads as 85% of cells matching exactly. What was computed: the prediction lies inside the 95% Monte Carlo interval of the measured bias in 85.1% of the 1224 cells (86.7% with finite-n centring), against 95% if prediction and interval were exact. Say 'inside the 95% Monte Carlo interval in 85% of cells'.
- `paper-repo` `dev`: `figtab-repo` pushed 37010a23cac4: "Table 2: absolute R2 split by target (log RMSE, log|bias|), held-out constant row, fits the text width at 8 pt; paper numbers in CAPTIONS.md and REPRODUCE.md"
- `figtab-repo` pushed 57f1a43f271c: "Table 2: absolute R2 split by target, held-out constant row, fits the text width"
- issue_comment created in `figtab-repo`#5 ("Review of version 2: Table 2 column targets and constant row; paper numbers in REPRODUCE.md and CAPTIONS.md") by `figtab-repo`  > Done on dev (37010a2): figures/, tables/, figures/gen/, CAPTIONS.md, REPRODUCE.md.
  > 
  > 1. Table 2: the absolute-R² column is split in two under "Absolute R² of": "log RMSE" holds (1), (1′) and the S_adj combined row (0.32, 0.34, 0.43); "log |bias|" holds (3ii), (3ii′) and the S_adj bias row (−0.12, −0.22, −0.06). The held-out constant is in the reference block of log |bias| (−0.239, shown −0.24, 1224 cells), read from `bias_reference.csv` row "constant (held-out training mean)". Reference rows for log RMSE stay in the log RMSE column as "leave one mechanism / family out". The threshold text is now "≥ 0.05, CI > 0". The old table was 424 pt wide against a 397 pt text; the new one sets itself at 8 pt (`\footnotesize` inside the file) and is 392 pt. For `appendix.tex`: the caption sentence "R² abs.: absolute held-out R² of log|bias|" no longer matches; the columns are named in the table head, and a caption sentence like "Absolute held-out R² is of log RMSE (2178 cells) or of log |bias| (1224 cells), as the column says" matches.
  > 2. Paper numbers: REPRODUCE.md section 9 now maps Fig. 9 to `figA9_orfit` and Fig. 10 to `fig6_cluster`. CAPTIONS.md headings carry the paper's number for every figure and table, with a numbering key at the top, and in-text references in the captions use the paper's numbers.
